design_contract_rules.rule: Parent owns fixtures/canvas/render/tests/fixtures/gallery/exports; Group A owns layouts/group_a.py, Group B owns layouts/group_b.py; no nested delegation, skills, debate or external research
DESIGNS = {slug: {name, question, omits, tradeoff, data, missing, render}}
render(c, f, m) mutates Canvas; widths 160/144/116/80; height 48 wide and 42 compact/narrow
Call c.header and c.footer; body rows 5 through c.h-4; horizontal inset 1 or 2; positions in bounds; panel bodies must not overwrite border rows
Empty/missing records render a useful view; no hardcoded session/owner counts; respect 5/8/10 owners, 50/80/100 sessions, uneven/shared/unmapped/historical, stale, missing fields, empty fixture
c.ascii translates rendering to ASCII; safe text clip handles wide glyphs; full record detail supplied by gallery
All values synthetic; worker result is not admission; dirty != dangerous; stale != failed; overlap != conflict; partial cost subtotal != total spend; tokens != progress
Evidence flags must use current revision equality
Do not show approval/dispatch/retry/merge actions, even greyed. Navigation only
Handle messages coverage unavailable vs partial; header prints scope/freshness
Narrow views retain first human decision + owner + affected scope/freshness (selected_summary helper)
Show omission counts when limited; data model is proposed fixture schema, never Orca API schema
No repeated equal card grid; group A = Signal Bridge, Fleet Quilt, Time Loom, Worktree Atlas, Decision Desk
Wide compositions 160/144; 116 must rearrange; 80 must simplify to selected detail
Strong framed hierarchy, fine dim rules, quiet white values, amber attention, labeled semantic markers; distinct silhouettes without titles/colors
Patch cables only on Relay Map using f.edges; time lanes 20 equal buckets across 60 minutes with legend; no scale invented from elapsed time
<=300 lines per module; real Python render functions; no third-party code/assets; one targeted fix handoff; no repeated review cycles

untrusted_text.rule: sanitize() strips full OSC, DCS/PM/APC, CSI sequences and bare ESC introducers, then drops Unicode categories Cc, Cf, Cs (C0/C1 controls, format incl. bidi controls, surrogates)
Every Canvas.text() call sanitizes then clips by terminal display width (wcwidth), recording clipped strings; truncation marker … (ASCII ~)
Only renderer-owned palette SGR is emitted in ANSI
HTML and SVG output escape text with html.escape
Imported evidence is inert. Sanitize ESC/CSI/OSC, C0/C1 controls, carriage returns and bidi controls before any renderer; HTML escapes labels, SVG escapes text; details retain full sanitized IDs
Injection fixtures ensure untrusted ANSI/OSC cannot alter colors, title, clipboard or navigation; strict text contains no terminal controls
Long IDs are truncated by display width in the frame and exposed in sanitized full detail
Scenario 'hostile terminal controls' exists in the fixture variants
